policy.name: dep-vref1-r1 — walk champion (hardware contract)
policy.notes: Walk champion of the deployment-contract line: trained on the exact robot interface — no real velocity feedback (meas:=ref), 25-deg tilt envelope, 0.05-0.06 m/s band. Hardware 08-10: walks, but twice built a runaway sideways lean ending in a tip (pinned-leg positive feedback). Implication: fine for short A/B runs, but expect a possible roll ramp — hit X the moment it leans past ~15 deg.

policy.name: holdbc1-hard1 stand/sit (HOLD+RISE 10M)
policy.notes: EXPERIMENTAL on hardware — watch it. Overnight 08-11 HOLD+RISE+LOWER specialist: quiet six-foot hold (feet factor 0.99-1.0), belly-to-plant rise tracks a recorded reference, trained lower/sit. Sim: hold 11/12 valid, crouch-start rise still tips 2/4 — NOT hardware-validated, no deployment-contract flags. Try SIT and HOLD first; for stand-up keep a hand ready and use Experiments tab tuck as the known-good fallback. Meta carries the TRAINED goal ramp (hold 5s, ramp 6s, +111mm): re-select/push this file before STAND — the 08-11-morning copy (md5 6620705c) lacks it and the runner falls back to the legacy +50mm/4s ramp, an out-of-distribution command for this policy.
